These compact FeatureCollections contain selected features from reviewed Berlin WFS responses in `/tmp/bplan_raw/full_{a_bp_iv,b_bp_fs,c_bp_ak}.json`; the reprojection edge-case fixture is from a subsequent provider response. They cover all three source layers, a slash-containing plan ID, a MultiPolygon, null and empty published fields, a valid source link, a four-digit historical date, and a valid source polygon that becomes self-intersecting when projected into WGS84. Tests mutate temporary copies for invalid inputs; the authored dataset configuration is not changed.
